```python
# Exact finite forward inference with explicit negation and rule priorities.
# Names containing spaces are represented with underscores.
money = {
    "bulldog": 63, "goat": 70, "liger": 31,
    "snake": 54, "swan": 13, "walrus": 7,
}
friends = {"bulldog": 18}

facts = set("""
basenji named Tarzan
bulldog in Colombia
dalmatian swears dragon
frog reduced_hours
llama wants fangtooth
mouse shouts finch
poodle has cello
poodle has keys
poodle has piano
snake card_color blue
snake in Colombia
snake named Lily
duck not_swims dolphin
""".strip().splitlines())

# Store numerical comparisons as computed, rather than assumed, facts.
if friends["bulldog"] > 8:
    facts.add("bulldog friends_gt_8")
if money["bulldog"] > money["swan"] + money["goat"]:
    facts.add("bulldog richer_than_swan_and_goat")
if money["snake"] > money["liger"] + money["walrus"]:
    facts.add("snake richer_than_liger_and_walrus")

animals = """
basenji bulldog dalmatian dragon frog goat liger llama fangtooth mouse
finch poodle snake swan walrus duck dolphin fish bee camel chihuahua
shark goose dove badger mule beaver pigeon ant leopard german_shepherd
bear gadwall seal flamingo crow elk lizard worm chinchilla seahorse
cobra coyote owl swallow songbird akita pelikan
""".split()

rules = []

def rule(number, head, *antecedents):
    rules.append((number, head, frozenset(antecedents)))

def opposite(literal):
    words = literal.split()
    predicate = words[1]
    words[1] = predicate[4:] if predicate.startswith("not_") else "not_" + predicate
    return " ".join(words)

# Basic semantic classification: both a cello and a piano are instruments.
rule(0, "poodle has instrument", "poodle has cello")
rule(0, "poodle has instrument", "poodle has piano")

# Universally quantified rules, including existential antecedents:
# an existential premise becomes one grounded rule per possible witness.
for x in animals:
    rule(1, f"{x} pays fish", f"{x} not_swims dolphin")
    rule(2, "llama not_destroys bee", f"{x} swears dragon")
    rule(4, "fish photo dove", f"{x} enjoys goose")
    rule(5, "mule not_photo beaver", f"{x} creates_castle badger")
    rule(11, "flamingo pays german_shepherd", f"{x} pays seal")
    rule(13, f"{x} not_builds gadwall", f"{x} shouts elk")
    rule(15, f"{x} not_pays german_shepherd", f"{x} builds lizard")
    rule(19, "worm pays seal", f"{x} leaves chinchilla")
    rule(20, f"{x} invests beaver", f"{x} not_destroys bee")
    rule(22, f"{x} refuses coyote", f"{x} unites cobra")
    rule(23, "chihuahua not_calls pelikan", f"{x} wants crow")
    rule(24, "owl photo german_shepherd", f"{x} refuses coyote")
    rule(26, "flamingo builds lizard", f"{x} neglects ant")
    rule(29, f"{x} not_stops leopard", f"{x} refuses chinchilla")
    rule(30, "swallow captures_king frog", f"{x} shouts finch")
    rule(32, f"{x} borrows chihuahua", f"{x} destroys seahorse")
    rule(33, "akita leaves chinchilla", f"{x} hides bear")
    rule(36, f"{x} calls pelikan",
         f"{x} reveals dragon", f"{x} surrenders shark")
    rule(40, "camel destroys seahorse", f"{x} photo dove")

rule(3, "chihuahua surrenders shark", "camel borrows chihuahua")
rule(6, "pigeon neglects ant", "snake borrows pigeon")
rule(7, "leopard swims poodle", "german_shepherd stops leopard")
rule(8, "poodle not_hides bear", "poodle has sharp_object")
rule(9, "gadwall enjoys goose", "fish builds gadwall")
rule(10, "snake borrows pigeon", "snake in France")
rule(12, "poodle wants crow", "leopard swims poodle")
rule(14, "bulldog creates_castle badger", "bulldog friends_gt_8")
rule(16, "bulldog creates_castle badger", "bulldog richer_than_swan_and_goat")
rule(17, "fish not_photo dove", "dolphin not_suspects fish")
rule(18, "poodle not_hides bear", "poodle watches pre_WW2_movie")
rule(21, "camel not_destroys seahorse", "gadwall not_brings_oil camel")
rule(25, "snake borrows pigeon", "snake richer_than_liger_and_walrus")
rule(27, "poodle hides bear", "poodle has instrument")
rule(28, "frog unites cobra", "swallow captures_king frog")
rule(31, "frog suspects songbird", "frog reduced_hours")
rule(34, "fish builds gadwall", "duck pays fish")
rule(35, "beaver borrows owl", "mule not_photo beaver")
rule(37, "beaver not_borrows owl", "llama invests beaver")
rule(38, "german_shepherd stops leopard",
     "owl photo german_shepherd", "flamingo not_pays german_shepherd")
rule(39, "poodle hides bear", "poodle not_has keys")

# (preferred rule, defeated rule)
preferences = {
    (13, 34), (15, 11), (17, 4), (18, 27), (18, 39),
    (21, 40), (29, 38), (35, 37), (36, 23),
    (8, 27), (8, 39),
}

def consequence_step(known):
    applicable = [r for r in rules if r[2] <= known]
    supporting = {}
    for number, head, body in applicable:
        supporting.setdefault(head, set()).add(number)

    result = set(facts)
    for number, head, body in applicable:
        opponents = supporting.get(opposite(head), ())
        if not any((other, number) in preferences for other in opponents):
            result.add(head)
    return result

known = set(facts)
seen = set()
while True:
    signature = frozenset(known)
    if signature in seen:
        print("UNSUPPORTED: priority inference did not reach a fixed point")
        break
    seen.add(signature)
    updated = consequence_step(known)
    if updated == known:
        assert consequence_step(known) == known

        positive = "chihuahua calls pelikan" in known
        negative = "chihuahua not_calls pelikan" in known

        print("Snake comparison:", money["snake"], ">",
              money["liger"] + money["walrus"],
              "=", money["snake"] > money["liger"] + money["walrus"])
        print("Flamingo pays german shepherd:",
              "flamingo pays german_shepherd" in known)
        print("Flamingo does not pay german shepherd:",
              "flamingo not_pays german_shepherd" in known)
        print("Poodle wants crow:", "poodle wants crow" in known)
        print("Chihuahua calls pelikan:", positive)
        print("Chihuahua does not call pelikan:", negative)

        if positive and negative:
            print("UNSUPPORTED: both query polarities were derived")
        else:
            expected = "proved" if positive else "disproved" if negative else "unknown"
            submitted = "unknown"
            print("Expected:", expected)
            print("Submitted:", submitted)
            print("CHECK PASS" if expected == submitted else "CHECK FAIL")
        break
    known = updated
```
